checkpoint: Starts from the pose Fly leaves the player on, Fuchsia's heal spot (25, 32) facing south: 11.02 (the Safari Zone, HM03 SURF and the GOLD TEETH) ends with a Fly to Fuchsia and is authored separately; until it is in, this row's start is its own (starts_after_unauthored_rows()).
PokeGuy's way (1:14:38 to 1:16:33): into the gym, Surf taught over Water Gun, Juggler Kirk fought (forced), round the top edge, Koga from the west. He fights nobody else.

The gym (FuchsiaCity_Gym map.json), 15 x 23, no running, its invisible walls in the map: Koga (7, 13) in the middle box, entered only from row 12 on the west. Its trainers and lines: Kayden (12, 16) south and east 4, Shawn (2, 9) west 1, Kirk (11, 11) east 3, Edgar (13, 4) every way 2, Phil (4, 6) every way 2, Nate (2, 16) south 4. Every way north crosses Kirk's line and one of Kayden's and Edgar's; the legs across a looker's line end on walls.

Ends west of Koga and saves there: his own pre-battle checkpoint (battle-checkpoint-retry), 12.02. Koga is a D7 fight: pokeguy entered at 34/122 HP and the PokemonSimulation benchmark wins 70.1% from that; this row enters at full HP and PP after the Center (the full-heal comparison is still pending there).
